collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A cook wonders whether people in busy distant places might eat while walking, without ever sitting down together.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a cook, wonders whether people in busy distant places might eat while walking, without ever sitting down together.

choices.label: Ask What a Meal Is For.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A villager imagines eating fruit on the way to work and admits they do that sometimes too.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An elder finds the idea sad and invites everyone to sit for a long meal.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A storyteller imagines distant feasts lasting all night, just like Isolan celebrations.

text_only.reason: a celebration or a happy feeling in the story; no celebration happens in the game -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A skeptic says both kinds might exist, depending on the day.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village agrees that sharing matters more than speed.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A villager who prefers to eat alone says sitting with others is not the only good way to eat, and the group considers that.
